- Positive indicators present: header "Rechnung", "Nummer", "Datum", itemized positions, "Gesamtbetrag Brutto", "Zahlbetrag", VAT lines ("USt"), invoice-like sections (billing/delivery addresses). No exclusion terms ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung") appear prominently. Conclusion: document is an invoice.

2) Locate candidate fields and possible ambiguities:
- Invoice.Date: Found "Datum 26.01.2024" near top. Clear, unambiguous.
- GrandTotal.Amount: Candidate totals:
  - "Gesamtbetrag Brutto 67,09 EUR" — gross total before skonto.
  - "Skonto brutto 4,00-% auf 67,09 ... 2,68- EUR"
  - "Zahlbetrag 64,41 EUR" — amount to be paid after skonto. Schema asks for "Total payable amount on the invoice" → choose "Zahlbetrag 64,41 EUR".
- Sender.VatId: Two VAT IDs appear:
  - Near top: "Ihre Ust-Id-Nr. ATU64131246" — labeled "Ihre" (your), likely the customer's VAT ID.
  - Footer: "Ust.-ID-Nr. ATU69710958" in company/registration block — likely sender's VAT ID. For Sender.VatId, choose ATU69710958.
- Vat.Rate / Net.Amount / Vat.Amount:
  - VAT block shows "R2 - 20,00% USt auf 55,91 ... 11,18 EUR" and "Gesamtbetrag Netto 55,91 EUR" and "Gesamtbetrag Brutto 67,09 EUR".
  - This implies VAT rate 20.00; net amount 55,91 EUR; VAT amount 11,18 EUR.
  - Ensure not to include per-line exchange rates or per-item VATs; this is whole-invoice VAT group R2 — appropriate to return.
- Number formatting: Input uses commas as decimal separators (e.g., 55,91). Schema requires numbers; preserve decimal places as in input but convert to numeric representation (use decimals with dot). Maintain same number of decimals: two decimals.

3) No-inference policy checks:
- All chosen fields appear explicitly; none are inferred beyond choosing the sender VAT from the footer (explicit label "Ust.-ID-Nr. ATU69710958").
- If any field were missing, it would be left empty; not the case here.

4) Final selected values (evidence references):
- Invoice.Date: "26.01.2024" (top header datum)
- GrandTotal.Amount: 64.41 (from "Zahlbetrag 64,41 EUR")
- Sender.VatId: "ATU69710958" (footer: "Ust.-ID-Nr. ATU69710958")
- Vat.Rate: 20.00 (from "R2 - 20,00% USt auf 55,91")
- Net.Amount: 55.91 (from "Gesamtbetrag Netto 55,91 EUR")
- Vat.Amount: 11.18 (from "11,18 EUR" adjacent to VAT line)

No conflicting multiple occurrences for these exact fields were found; chosen occurrences are the most directly labeled and invoice-level.
reasoning.step2:
I will assess confidence for each extracted field based on text evidence and consistency.

- Invoice.Date (26.01.2024)
  - Evidence: Explicit "Datum 26.01.2024" at top near "Nummer".
  - Consistency: Single unambiguous occurrence.
  - Confidence: High.

- GrandTotal.Amount (64.41)
  - Evidence: Explicit "Zahlbetrag 64,41 EUR" (amount to be paid after skonto).
  - Consistency: Matches gross (67,09) minus skonto (2,68) = 64,41; arithmetic consistent.
  - Potential ambiguity: Could have chosen "Gesamtbetrag Brutto 67,09" but schema requests total payable amount.
  - Confidence: High.

- Sender.VatId (ATU69710958)
  - Evidence: Footer lists "Ust.-ID-Nr. ATU69710958" in company block (CREATON GmbH).
  - Potential ambiguity: Top shows "Ihre Ust-Id-Nr. ATU64131246" (customer VAT) — risk of selecting seller vs. buyer VAT if misinterpreted.
  - Resolution: Footer company block clearly corresponds to sender; chosen accordingly.
  - Confidence: Medium-High.

- Vat.Rate (20.00)
  - Evidence: Line "R2 - 20,00% USt auf 55,91".
  - Consistency: Standard VAT rate; matches VAT calculation (55,91 * 0.20 = 11,182 → shown 11,18 with rounding).
  - Confidence: High.

- Net.Amount (55.91)
  - Evidence: "Gesamtbetrag Netto 55,91 EUR".
  - Consistency: Net + VAT = 55,91 + 11,18 = 67,09 gross shown; arithmetic consistent.
  - Confidence: High.

- Vat.Amount (11.18)
  - Evidence: "11,18 EUR" shown adjacent to VAT line.
  - Consistency: Matches 20% of 55,91 when rounded to two decimals.
  - Confidence: High.
